formats.title: Data formats
formats.teaser: CSV, Excel and JSON with full control over the import
formats.loading: Data is loaded from files to the backing data storage through Koia itself or it may be written to it by a third party program.
formats.supported: The following file types are supported.
formats.control: When importing a file, you're granted full control over which portions of the data should be imported. You're also in control over...
formats.dataTypes: The data types to be used for storing the values in the data storage
formats.displayFormat: The format to be applied for displaying certain values

scene.title: What is a scene?
scene.teaser: One scene per data set, switch between them at any time
scene.text: Once loaded to the data storage, individual datasets are each represented by a Scene. You can switch between different scenes as you please.
scene.items: Scenes can be given a user-defined name and description. They also contain the following items.
scene.origin: Information about the origin of the loaded data (i.e. file name and modification date).
scene.link: A link to the loaded raw data in the data storage.
scene.columns: The name, data type, width and format of individual data columns.
scene.views: View definitions that were saved by the user in order to be restored later on.

views.title: Views
views.teaser: Raw data table, pivot tables and dashboards
views.rawData: The Raw Data table presents the data in an unprocessed form in pages of adjustable size. The table offers sorting and filtering of individual columns.
views.pivotBeforeLink: The Pivot Table is a powerful tool to compute, summarize, and analyze data, with revealing patterns and trends. It's based on amazing
views.pivotAfterLink: that offers many different views (e.g. heatmaps and table barcharts) and lets you shape the pivot table through drag and drop of individual columns.
views.dashboard: A Dashboard contains a variable number of elements (summary tables, charts and graphs). In grid layout, the elements are held in a fixed grid of customizable dimension, they may fit into a single cell or spread over several columns and rows. When the window size changes, the element size also changes in order to always fit the allocated grid space. In flex layout, each element has a specific size that is not changed when the window size changes, the elements are however automatically laid out according to the available window space.
views.tabs: Any number of pivot tables and dashboards may be opened as individual tabs next to the raw data table. Open tabs are kept with the scene.

reader.csvDescription:
CSV (Comma Separated Values) is plain text of tabular form.
Each line represents a row and individual fields of these rows must be separated by the same character (i.e. comma).
reader.excelDescription:
Microsoft Excel is composed of one or several spreadsheets that contain data in tabular form.
It is expected that column names appear in the first row of the selected spreadsheet.
reader.excelSheetNameDescription: Name of Excel sheet that contains the data
reader.jsonDescription:
JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is formatted and self-describing text for storing and interchanging data.
You import an array of flat (non-nested) objects by specifying its JSONPath.
reader.jsonPathDescription: JSONPath to the object array that contains the data
